# QR dependency

Project Nayuki QR Code generator, MIT license retained in qrcodegen.js.
Downloaded 2026-10-10 from https://www.nayuki.io/res/qr-code-generator-library/qrcodegen.js

Upstream download SHA-256: `2511bc17f40a3c41d4a0578995db956b38997334d3d20113a5d4dc5c49c69480`.
Local changes: normalize line endings/trailing whitespace and append a named native ES module export.
No runtime CDN, package installation or compilation is required.
Only QR generation is used; URLs are never sent to the vendor.

Documentation: https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library
